name: Fendlerbush
desc: Fendlerbush (Fendlera rupicola): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 70 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Fendlera rupicola, commonly known as the cliff fendlerbush or the false mockorange, is a shrub that grows in dry locations in the south central mountain regions of North America.
